annotations.title: Customs Rules On Entry By Car

description: Customs rules when driving into a country, optionally from a given country: food bans, cash declaration, alcohol and tobacco limits, goods value, fuel in a canister. Each rule carries a verbatim official quote and source link. A country without data returns an error saying so — never present that as "nothing is restricted". Use it for what you may bring in by car: alcohol, tobacco, cash, meat and other food, goods limits.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country you enter, e.g. PL.

from.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country you come from, e.g. UA. Matters: no customs inside the EU, and some bans have exemptions by origin.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.
